title: Thoryn CLI connection contract
description: SSO-2948 (epic SSO-2947) — a schema-backed, declarative sign-in configuration for the `thoryn` CLI: HOW a caller (a person for their own use cases, or a CI pipeline dogfooding the same feature) signs the CLI into a given workspace/identity. It is DATA, not code — a sibling of the recipe schema — passed to `thoryn login --connection <file>`. The workspace slug derives the per-tenant issuer (`https://<slug>.hub.<env>`) and gateway; the client authenticates by the client-credentials grant. The SECRET is NEVER in this file — only the NAME of the environment variable that carries it (`auth.secretEnv`); a client id is public and MAY appear.

workspace.description: The workspace this CLI binds to. Its slug derives the per-tenant hub issuer and gateway.

slug.description: Workspace slug (same grammar as a recipe workspace slug). Derives https://<slug>.hub.<env>.

hubBaseUrlEnv.description: NAME of the environment variable holding the hub base URL (e.g. https://hub.stg.thoryn.org). The per-tenant issuer is derived by prefixing the slug on that host. Defaults to THORYN_HUB; when unset the CLI's baked-in default hub is used.

auth.description: How the CLI authenticates into the workspace.

method.description: Authentication method. Only the non-interactive client-credentials grant is a connection method today.

clientId.description: OAuth client id of the machine client. PUBLIC — a client id is not a secret and MAY be committed.

secretEnv.description: NAME of the environment variable holding the client secret (a GitHub secret in CI; a locally-exported var for a developer). NEVER the secret value itself.

scopes.description: The EXACT scope set requested — the ceiling AND the floor (the hub grants only what is requested). Non-empty, unique, each a tenant:<resource>.<verb> scope.
